strategy.overview: Repeat the right orbit as it rises through 20,000, 30,000, 40,000, 50,000, and 60,000; the next completion starts double playfield scoring for the rest of the ball. Complete the top 1-2-3 lanes to light the upper-left lock, lock one ball there, then complete 1-2-3 again to light the far-left lock. Shoot the far-left lock to capture the second ball and start three-ball Multiball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Repeat the right orbit until it starts double playfield scoring for the rest of the ball. Complete top 1-2-3, lock at the upper-left saucer, complete 1-2-3 again, then lock at the far-left saucer to start three-ball Multiball.
strategy.summary: Prioritize the repeatable right orbit for a rest-of-ball doubler. For Multiball, complete 1-2-3 and lock upper-left, then repeat 1-2-3 and lock far-left.

quickInfo.name: Repeat the Right Orbit
quickInfo.summary: Its ladder leads to double playfield scoring for the ball.

quickInfo.name: Complete 1-2-3
quickInfo.summary: The first set lights the upper-left lock.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Repeat 1-2-3, then shoot the far-left lock.

steps.text: Repeat the right orbit through its 20,000-to-60,000 ladder; the next completion starts double playfield scoring for the rest of the ball.
Complete the top 1-2-3 lanes to light the upper-left lock, then shoot that saucer to capture the first ball.
Complete 1-2-3 again to light the far-left lock.
Shoot the far-left lock to capture the second ball and release all three balls for Multiball.

alternatives.title: Build Bonus X
alternatives.when: Use this when a return-lane feed is controlled.

steps.text: Roll through a lit return lane to advance Bonus X toward 5x, then return to the right-orbit doubler route.

buildsToward.title: Combine Multiball with the rest-of-ball doubler

steps.text: Finish the right-orbit ladder before taking the second lock when the orbit is safe.
Start three-ball Multiball only after double playfield scoring is running.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count, lock memory, Extra Ball and Special conversions, Cosmic Ball settings, and Bonus X maximum.
Test the right orbit and value lamps, top 1-2-3 lanes and lane change, both left locks and releases, X-Y lanes, drop banks, and all three balls.

cautions.issue: The right-orbit value is held, but the playfield doubler lasts only for the current ball.
cautions.response: Finish the ladder early enough to use the doubler on locks and Multiball.
